title: Clayface
copy: A horror actor who became living clay and can reshape his face and body into anyone else.

title: Batman
copy: Gotham’s detective. He has no powers, only training, and he took up the work after his parents were murdered.

title: Vision
copy: An android Ultron built from Wonder Man’s brain patterns. He joined the Avengers and can change his own density.

title: Ultron
copy: A robot Hank Pym created from a copy of his own mind. Ultron turns on that maker and on humanity.

title: Green Lantern
copy: A power ring turns willpower into green light. Test pilot Hal Jordan and architect John Stewart have both worn one.

title: Sinestro
copy: Once the finest Green Lantern of his sector. Cast out, he founded a corps whose yellow rings feed on fear.

title: Doctor Doom
copy: The armored monarch of Latveria, a scientist and sorcerer who blames Reed Richards for the scars under his mask.

title: Fantastic Four
copy: Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm, and Ben Grimm, a family of explorers transformed by cosmic rays.

title: Spider-Man
copy: A student bitten by a radioactive spider, who holds that great power comes with great responsibility.

title: Venom
copy: A reporter fused with the alien symbiote Spider-Man cast off. The two of them share a hatred of Peter Parker.
